description: Kerberoasting attack on Service Principal Names (SPN) with hash cracking -- a medium-tier active directory challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Kerberoasting attack on Service Principal Names (SPN) with hash cracking"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
